question: Ramabhar Stupa, which marks the site where Lord Buddha was cremated, is situated in which state of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Uttar Pradesh**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Buddha was born in the Lumbini, Nepal and is considered the founder of Buddhism.**

 
 
• He was also called Sakyamuni because he belongs to the Sakya clan.
 
 
 
• At the age of 35, **Gautama buddha or Siddhartha got enlightenment in Bodh Gaya** under the Bodhi tree on Vishaka Purnima.
 
• **He gave his first sermon at Sarnath in Uttat Pradesh.**
 
• In 487 BC, Buddha had reached Kushinagar and attained Parinirvana and due to illness, he died in Kushinagar.
 
 
• **His body was cremated at Ramabhar Stupa, Kushinagar, Uttar Pradesh. Hence option 4 is correct. **
 
• **This is called Mahaparinirvana** which is one of the goals of Buddhism and Buddhist text Mahaparinibbana Sutta mentions the death of Lord Buddha at the age of 80.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The stupa was built over a portion of Buddha's ashes and he was cremated by the ancient Malla tribes.**
 
• Ancient Buddhist texts reveal that the Ramabhar stupa has been referred to as Mukut-Bandhan Vihar.
 
• After getting enlightenment at Sarnath, Buddha shared four Noble Truths or Dharma.
 
 
• **The truth of suffering, the truth of the cause of suffering, the truth of the end of suffering, and the truth of the path that leads to the end of suffering.**
